affinity.notes: Radiant energy, halos, and luminous wing-like structures dominate so completely that the creature appears constructed from unexplained light.

anatomy.notes: The central body is lost inside overlapping wings, rings, and luminous fragments.

archetype.notes: Divine area controller communicates the orrery-of-orders control duty.

counterplay.notes: The dense radial spectacle obscures attack direction, vulnerable anatomy, and any readable charge or recovery state.

finish.notes: Near-white energy and filigree flatten depth and obscure material form.

framing.notes: Broad wing mass fills the panel without a stable creature focal point.

identity.notes: Many-winged celestial apparition identifies the Seraph form.

tier.notes: Blind reviewer perceived T5; exact intended tier is T5.
